A guide to shade areas at the skyport
The desk wrote this for regular visitors
Shade areas for companion animals

The shaded waiting areas at Aurelia Skyways are meant to help pets stay calm, cool, and comfortable before boarding. The Companion Animal Travel Desk can direct you to the nearest resting space and explain how to move through the skyport with care.

Please keep your pet close, use a secure carrier or leash, and follow staff guidance while waiting. If your pet needs a quieter corner, tell the welcome team promptly so they can offer the most suitable space. Courteous communication helps the process move smoothly for everyone.

Travelers who arrive early often find it easier to settle their animals before the busy boarding period begins. Bring water, a familiar blanket, and any approved comfort item that may help your pet relax. If you are traveling with Rosie or another companion animal, short calm pauses in the shade can make a real difference.

<<FACT F028>> The quarantine room is used only when staff determine that separate care is needed, and the welcome team will explain the next steps with respect and clarity. Keep all documents ready and respond quickly to any request from the desk so your journey can continue without unnecessary delay.

<<FACT F007>> When the skyport is nearing capacity, staff may guide later arrivals to alternate arrangements or different waiting areas, always with the animal's welfare in mind. This helps Aurelia Skyways maintain safe conditions for every traveler and every pet.

For further assistance, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at the skyport.
